_comment: Hand-edited lore about the solids: durable metadata that must survive
regeneration of the grid (V/E/F) files, which are tool-written and may be
rebuilt at any time. build_catalogue.py reads this file and folds it into
data/grids.json alongside what it reads from the grid files, so an edit
here takes effect after the next build_catalogue.py run.
'solids' is keyed by gridId; each value is a dictionary of that solid's
attributes, so new kinds of lore (a preferred link, say) slot in beside
'aliases' without changing the file's shape. A solid with no lore simply
'duals' lists each dual pair ONCE, unordered, rather than a 'dual' field
on both solids: symmetry then holds by construction. Only pairs where
both solids are in data/ belong here; add the pair when the missing dual
arrives. Self-dual solids are not listed -- that is what the 'self-dual'
category in the grid file says.
